question: The split in Indian National Congress occured in __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1907.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The split in **Indian National Congress** occurred in **1907.**
 
• **The split was a result of ideological differences between the moderates and the extremists.**
 
• The moderates believed in the** peaceful and gradual approach** towards gaining independence from the British rule.
 
• The extremists, on the other hand, believed in a more** **radical approach and were willing to use violence if necessary.
 
• The split led to the formation of two factions within the Congress -** the Garam Dal (Extremist faction) and the Naram Dal (Moderate faction)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The year **1905 **is significant in the history of Indian National Congress as it was the year when the** partition of Bengal **was announced by **Lord Curzon**, which led to widespread protests and agitation across the country.
